_meta.target_A: ssim_y closest to 0.9961 (camera-equivalent: libjpeg-turbo at the cameras' IJG-equivalent q94 on the same camera models' raw YUY2 1080p frames; camera_jpeg_quality.json)
_meta.target_B: psnr_y closest to 45.0 dB, stored under key 'psnr45' (lower quality than A on this content)
_meta.apply: open the encoder with exactly 'options' (PyAV CodecContext.options / simplejpeg kwargs / nvimgcodec EncodeParams), pix_fmt 'pix_fmt_fed', gop_size as given, max_b_frames=0; JPEG paths are fed full-range samples, H.264/HEVC paths limited-range (NOTES.md section 2)
_meta.input_classes: yuy2_1080p, yuy2_720p (derived by swscale), mjpeg_720p, mjpeg_1080p (camera JPEG decoded)
_meta.metric_note: for mjpeg_* classes the metrics are generation loss vs the decoded camera frame
